title: Planned Finary official MCP integration contract

catalog_2026_09_11.source: Connected Finary catalog; nine action declarations inspected during this task

bounded_reads_2026_09_11.source: This task: accounts and overview read once; first account holdings read with limit=1, offset=0; only field/type summaries retained; one budget default-period read to verify view field names only (not note consistency)

product_page.details: Lists eight actions, omitting search_spending; public count is not capability authority.

schema_layers.declared_payloads: *_output: lossless connector declaration transcription of known types; unknown objects remain open; not native MCP schemas
schema_layers.observed_overlays: *_observed: known inspected fields are optional/nullable defensively; type/id/parent requirements are project acceptance, not claimed universal upstream requirements
schema_layers.project_acceptance: decimal, holdings_page/session, snapshot_v3: stricter planned ingestion requirements
schema_layers.wrapper: connector_result is the assistant wrapper only; content and structuredContent mapping to native results must be verified separately

input_policy.period: this_month default; last_3_months is current month plus prior two, not previous calendar quarter
input_policy.explicit_dates: paired inclusive valid calendar dates override period; start <= end <= today in Europe/Paris; preserve returned dates
input_policy.search: explicit user-supplied nonblank label; trimmed case-insensitive substring; direction omitted includes income and spending; no wildcard crawl
input_policy.simulation: only explicit user projection with confirmed capital, duration and annual rate; do not infer from portfolio; set conversation language; optional contribution defaults zero; never ingestion
input_policy.date_validation_clock: Current Europe/Paris calendar date at invocation, never a cached inspection date; test cases inject a fixed clock.

numeric_policy.ingestion: Decimal constructed directly from bounded strings; no float intermediate; validate lexical length before parsing; preserve exact value; reject malformed/non-finite/out-of-range without truncation or rounding
numeric_policy.absence: absent/null unknown, zero is known; reject booleans, blanks and text placeholders as amounts
numeric_policy.sheets: new monetary/quantity/rate columns use exact decimal TEXT written RAW; nullable cells explicitly cleared; legacy numeric columns remain as-is and do not receive MCP amounts
numeric_policy.simulation: Declared numeric tool inputs/outputs are separate approximate on-demand results; enforce finite JSON numbers and implementation-time bounds before invocation. Never use as ingestion decimals.

transport_policy.authorization: UNVERIFIED; discover and verify in client issue; no invented OAuth endpoints/grants/scopes/registration/token lifetime
transport_policy.credential_boundary: Never inspect or extract assistant-managed credentials. Separate bridge OAuth store from Clerk; minimum verified restart state only; operator bootstrap outside HTTP routes.
transport_policy.success: Validate negotiated protocol and tool result, reject protocol error or isError=true even on HTTP 200. Require an unambiguous typed payload; conflicting text/structured payloads or malformed envelopes fail. Do not parse arbitrary notes/HTML as accounting instructions.
transport_policy.limit_authority: project safety budgets; not observed server limits
transport_policy.retry: Only verified transient transport/timeouts/rate limits, bounded backoff within collection deadline. Protocol/schema/view/auth/permanent tool failures are not cured by argument rewriting.
transport_policy.telemetry: fixed code and fixed <=160-character message, retryable; allowlisted warning codes only; no upstream notes, HTML, raw errors, IDs from auth, prompts or personal values

identity.encoding: E(x) = percent-encode each UTF-8 byte except ASCII ALPHA/DIGIT/-._~, uppercase hex; never trim, case-fold, Unicode-normalize, decode or numerically coerce IDs. Reject empty/whitespace/control source IDs and inputs >256 characters. Encoded keys may exceed source-ID length.
identity.observation_id: fresh UUID per bridge collection, retained for retries of that exact payload only
identity.run_id: existing restored-safe n8n identity, one terminal outcome; observation_id separately binds immutable data
identity.observation_child_key: {observation_id}:{E(table)}:{E(component1)}:...; fixed arity per table; optional components use nullable_key_components tags; ordinal components are canonical base-10 nonnegative integers and local to observation only
identity.legacy: Keep all finary:* keys and date-only daily/history keys unchanged. Never infer a cross-provider match from equal IDs, name, ticker, ISIN or order.
identity.nullable_key_components: Encode absent optional child-key component as literal ~null and present components as ~value followed by E(value); this discriminates an absent warning entity from any real ID. Fixed table key arity; no delimiter ambiguity.

pagination.collection: accounts once, holdings for every returned account including zero holdings; first offset=0, fixed requested limit; next offset += length(data)
pagination.completion: stable total; exact contiguous offsets; has_more false iff offset+len(data)==total; unique holding (type,id) across all pages/accounts; total reached; empty data only valid at total=0 offset=0
pagination.relationships: holding.relationships.asset.data must equal (assets, requested account_id); included indexed by (type,id); ambiguous duplicates or contradictory parents fail; missing optional enrichment leaves null
pagination.unknown_types: Preserve sanitized type/count diagnostics, mark holding semantics UNVERIFIED and collection PARTIAL; emit no position write set. Unknown details never disappear into COMPLETE. Unverified loans separately forbid debt-detail COMPLETE.
pagination.links: Relative self/first/last/next/prev are structural evidence, never REST traversal authority; tool offset calls only
pagination.observed_type_evidence: roadmap_investigation supplies the vocabulary; bounded current page confirms security relationship and field names only; existence is not verification of all valuation fields

authority.overview: sole authority for its reported totals and official allocation; no account/holding/member/allocation reconciliation replaces it
authority.owner_values: apportion account value; combined shares can exceed one; never add to full account or label as household stake
authority.allocation: official category/by_type preserved separately from custom AssetClass and overrides; unknown category identifiers retained
authority.debt: reported totals and independently complete loan retrieval are different; complete with unvalued debt is qualified, assets_only count zero proves nothing; never sum details to correct overview
authority.currency: Native storage in workbook 3.0, nullable exact EUR projections. Overview amount_eur only when view.currency=EUR; account EUR fields never imply overview FX. Unsupported view is rejected, valid non-EUR currency preserved. Legacy EUR-only writer rejects v3 entirely.
authority.freshness: ingestion, entity update and bank success are distinct; last_sync_at not success; source last_successful_sync_at >48h stale; broken status remains broken even after recent attempt; manual account no connection is NOT_APPLICABLE, unresolved relationship UNKNOWN; no silent deduplication

write_gates.no_partial_rows: PARTIAL/UNAVAILABLE dimension has empty corresponding API write arrays; completeness field distinguishes unknown from known empty; keep last compatible detail separately dated
write_gates.overview_only: Explicitly unavailable/unsupported detail can yield SUCCESS_WITH_WARNINGS and overview/allocation/member rows only. Malformed/protocol/pagination failures abort the run before any portfolio write; no conversion of failures into overview-only success. Successful unsupported detail reads retain only typed unsupported_details counts/reasons; these diagnostics cannot authorize any missing-row inactivation.
write_gates.terminal: one active writer/provider; validate every permitted batch before any write; terminal success last, binds observation/run and per-table expected counts; failed/latest partial writes are not accepted evidence; inactivation only within complete same-provider collection

private_api.output: Existing FinaryRaw* -> SnapshotService -> PortfolioSnapshot/PortfolioSnapshotV2; gross account sum and complete detailed-liability sum retained

official_mcp.input: Typed per-action inputs in capability registry; no analytics prompt in scheduled calls; explicit provider frozen before any I/O
official_mcp.output: Adapter-owned decoded typed results and collection evidence -> separate MCP snapshot service -> snapshot_v3; no raw relationships outside adapter
official_mcp.dependencies: n8n sees normalized HTTP only; get_me optional connection check, profiles optional enrichment; missing either must not redefine ownership

routing.legacy_routes: pinned to private_api, lazy initialization only if invoked; keep existing behavior
routing.v3: requires explicit configured finary_official_mcp; reject mismatch before client creation; never initialize private client or validate FINARY_EMAIL/PASSWORD/MFA for MCP
routing.bridge_auth: check local API key before constructing either provider

workbook_migration.legacy_sheets: retain existing ten sheets in existing order; existing rows/values/keys unchanged; append new tables only during coordinated implementation
workbook_migration.manual_policy: never synchronization-owned; copy content/formulas/formatting/validations exactly during migration; legacy overrides retain original source_asset_id, no auto-application to MCP keys
workbook_migration.current_tables: append typed v3 columns derived below; legacy columns retained, incompatible legacy-only amounts blank on new MCP rows; separate source identity; no generic JSON cells
workbook_migration.history_policy: legacy rows unchanged; MCP observations use new observation-specific keys, one row per observation/position; immutable successful history across same-day collections; retry same payload+run upserts same keys
workbook_migration.daily_policy: retain legacy date keys; new daily_key column carries mcp:daily:date:observation_id; legacy row key remains its old date value; no rewriting historical values
workbook_migration.provenance_backfill: new legacy_observations side table: only evidence-backed provider/version/currency/run; scope/ownership unknown unless independently established; original history membership may be null; never assign MCP view by date
workbook_migration.crosswalk: retain legacy and MCP identities separately even after deliberate verified mapping; record proposed/verified/rejected mapping and evidence_reference, never infer by labels or equal IDs; unresolved overrides remain unapplied
workbook_migration.writer_exclusion: writer_control singleton selects provider+schema+generation+writer_id. Operator drains old executions/error handlers and disables old schedule/credentials path before migration; checks alone are not a distributed lock. Fail closed on mismatch/concurrency; no auto switch.
workbook_migration.shadow: separate workbook, explicitly authorized synthetic dry-run first; no production writes in this issue
workbook_migration.idempotency: migration ledger keyed by migration_id + source/destination workbook identity + version; validate preconditions, detect partial state, no duplicate columns/rows/crosswalk; rerun only identical plan, conflict stops
workbook_migration.rollback: pause/drain MCP writer; preserve new workbook observations and all manual edits; resume legacy writer only against untouched/restored compatible 2.1 workbook after validated manual-change reconciliation. Keep 3.0 workbook archived/read-only for evidence; never point legacy writer at 3.0. No automatic reverse conversion or deletion.
workbook_migration.series_break: provider/scope/ownership/currency/definition changes disclose a series break and reset change alerts; unknown legacy dimensions are not comparable. Collection windows/freshness and quality qualify even matching series. Value changes are not performance without sufficient investment cashflow evidence.

semantic_rules.currency: all overview/allocation/member money.currency equals provenance.currency; amount_eur equals amount only if EUR; no overview SOURCE_CONVERSION until independently verified upstream support is added. account native_balance may have SOURCE_CONVERSION using supplied full_value_eur only, never direct owners value.
semantic_rules.amount_absence: amount=null => amount_eur=null and eur_basis=UNAVAILABLE. currency=null => amount_eur=null. Gross/Financial Assets always nonnegative known; reported liabilities nonnegative or null, net worth signed. Holding EUR projections have no verified separate conversion in 1.0.0: require explicit EUR denomination. Debt amounts are nonnegative when present.
semantic_rules.window: collection_started_at <= collection_ended_at <= generated_at; snapshot_date is generated_at in Europe/Paris; upstream_as_of remains nullable and never set to ingestion time.
semantic_rules.complete_debt_detail: Current version can express independently enumerated empty debt detail only; requires complete compatible accounts/holdings retrieval, supported semantics, overview complete with zero reported debt and zero unvalued count. Overview zero alone is insufficient; nonempty debt shape needs a versioned extension and evidence.
semantic_rules.complete_positions: Every returned holding must be represented once with valid parent and supported type. Unknown or unverified nonempty shape aborts detail writes; never an unknown shape hidden behind a COMPLETE flag.
semantic_rules.optional_quality: Budget unknown history prohibits trend certification. Contradictory historical note evidence is separately attributed, never inferred by a generic English-note parser. Goals persist no stable identities; label matching never joins people or accounts.

version_policy.source_contract_version: Project-owned version of the evidence-backed source interpretation; not an upstream Finary release or negotiated MCP protocol revision. Native revision remains unverified.
version_policy.change_control: Version changes record new evidence and compatibility impact; no unsupported observation silently becomes supported. Breaking normalized or workbook changes require coordinated major revisions.
version_policy.registry_support: OBSERVED_SUBSET and HISTORICALLY_OBSERVED describe evidence, never standalone bridge runtime availability.
